_meta.description: Credit card rewards optimization rules. Chase trifecta + household card portfolio.
_meta.strategy: Pool all Chase UR points into Sapphire Reserve for 1.5¢/point portal redemption or transfer to airline/hotel partners. Use the highest-earning card per category.

chase_trifecta.strategy_summary: Freedom Flex and Freedom Unlimited earn UR points that transfer to the Sapphire Reserve, where they're worth 1.5¢ each through the Chase Travel portal or can be transferred 1:1 to airline/hotel partners.

perks: Priority Pass Select lounge access (cardholder + 2 guests)
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years

fee_roi_breakeven.notes: With $500/mo dining + $300 travel credit, ROI is strongly positive.

quarterly_rotating.activation_reminder: Activate at chase.com/freedom or Chase app within first month of each quarter

freedom_flex.notes: Points transfer to Sapphire Reserve pool. 5% quarterly categories are the highest-earning opportunity in the trifecta.

freedom_unlimited.notes: Flat 1.5% catch-all. Use this for any purchase that doesn't earn more on another card. Points transfer to Sapphire Reserve pool.

amazon_prime.reward_type: Amazon cashback (statement credit or Amazon balance)
amazon_prime.notes: Always use for Amazon and Whole Foods. Do NOT use for dining (Sapphire Reserve 3x is better at 1.5¢/point = 4.5% effective).

capital_one_venture_x.notes: Use for non-Chase travel bookings and as a 2x catch-all when 1.5x Chase isn't available. Anniversary bonus + travel credit make effective fee negative.

perks: Spotify rebate (up to $13.99/mo reimbursed in CRO)
crypto_com_ruby.notes: Niche use. Spotify rebate is the main value. 2% CRO cashback has volatility risk. Don't use as primary card.

optimal_card_selection._instructions: For each purchase, select the card that maximizes effective return. Chase UR points are valued at 1.5¢/point when redeemed through Sapphire Reserve portal.

by_category.override: Freedom Flex during Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun) when Amazon is a 5% category — use Flex to earn transferable UR points instead of Amazon cashback

by_category.runner_up: Freedom Flex / Freedom Unlimited at 3% (but 3x × 1.5¢ = 4.5% via CSR is same; CSR wins for travel insurance)

by_category.best_card: Chase Sapphire Reserve (via Chase Travel portal for 10x)
by_category.notes: Book through Chase Travel portal for 10x. Direct purchases earn 3x = 4.5% effective.

by_category.fallback: Amazon Prime Card at 2%, or Capital One Venture X at 2%

by_category.best_card: Chase Freedom Flex or Freedom Unlimited

by_category.notes: No card in the portfolio earns bonus on in-store grocery. Venture X 2x or Freedom Unlimited 1.5x UR (=2.25% effective) are close. CFU wins if counting UR transfer value.
CSR earns 3x on online grocery orders
Spotify rebate is the primary value prop of the Ruby card

by_category.critical: MUST activate each quarter at chase.com/freedom

wrong_card_alerts.mistake: Using Amazon Prime Card for dining
Using Sapphire Reserve for Amazon purchases

wrong_card_alerts.correct: Use Freedom Flex (same 3%, but Flex also builds toward rotating bonus)

wrong_card_alerts.mistake: Using any card for Spotify except Crypto.com Ruby
wrong_card_alerts.correct: Ruby gives full rebate in CRO
Book via Chase Travel for 10x instead of 3x

wrong_card_alerts.mistake: Using Sapphire Reserve for general non-bonus spend
Forgetting to activate Freedom Flex quarterly categories
